title: Dental clinic

fields.label: Opening hours
fields.help: In your own words, e.g. Mon-Thu 8-6, Fri 8-3, Sat 9-1, closed Sunday.

fields.label: Visits people can book
fields.help: Two to eight reasons to book (cleaning, first visit, emergency...), how long each takes and who sees them.

fields.label: Prices
fields.help: Your fees for cleanings, exams, fillings, crowns, whitening and so on, and your whitening price.

fields.label: Your team
fields.help: Dentists and hygienists with their titles and what each does.

fields.label: What new patients ask
fields.help: Optional: first-visit length, what to bring, cancellation policy, nervous patients, payment plans.

fields.label: How should the site sound?
fields.help: A few words about your practice and patients.

fields.label: Brand colour
fields.help: Optional: a colour name or hex code.

writerNotes: The hero is a fixed animation of an in-office whitening visit: a drawn smile whitens from shade A3.5 to BL2 against a shade guide over a 90-minute visit. hero.priceLabel and hero.price name the clinic's whitening treatment and its price (e.g. "$495 · 90 min"); if the clinic doesn't offer whitening, use its best-known cosmetic treatment and say so in the title, never invent a price (ask with _blocked).

booking.reasons: 2-8 reasons to book, each with minutes (a multiple of 5), a short note and who the patient sees. Leave out 'id'. booking.facts are 2-4 short true facts from the brief (open Saturdays, emergency slots, kids welcome).

prices are in four fixed groups: preventive (exams, cleanings, X-rays), basic (fillings, extractions, deep cleaning), major (root canals, crowns, bridges), cosmetic (whitening, veneers). Each item has a name, a short note (time or detail) and a whole-number price. The page has an insurance toggle that shows typical plan coverage (100/80/50/0%); prices.body and prices.note explain it in the clinic's words, and only mention deductibles, maximums or membership plans the brief gives. prices.year is the cost of a year of check-ups, from the brief's own prices (two cleanings, two exams, X-rays), described in prices.yearNote.
The tooth chart is fixed (US Universal numbering 1-32); chart.body introduces it. Outside the US, say that the chart uses the US numbering.

faq.items: 3-8 questions new patients ask, answered from the brief in one to three short paragraphs; **bold** the key number. Never invent a policy, a price or a sedation option the brief doesn't give.
team: 1-4 people with name and title as the clinic writes them (e.g. Dr. Ana Ruiz, DDS) and what they do; the page shows their initials in a circle.
hours: Sunday to Saturday, null = closed, on the hour or half hour. The hours table and the open-now line are made from them.

business.short is the name in the nav (with business.kind beside it on desktop, e.g. 'Dental'); business.wordmark is the giant footer word. Both are the practice's own name, never a different one. theme.wordmarkFit: always "fit" for a new business.
theme.accent is the brand colour for buttons and links (white text on it): a fairly deep colour. theme.tint tints the dark hero stage and the pale page (lightness stays, only the hue changes).
business.name is set to exactly the name in the brief and cannot be changed.
